label: Some thought episode occurs under the supplied occurrence predicate, from retorsion
meaning: Some thought episode occurs, from a performed doubt whether thought occurs (STMT-COGITO-DOUBT-IS-PERFORMED, OPEN), the conclusion of COGITO-PERFORMED-DOUBT-SELF-REFUTING (performing such a doubt makes its content 'no thought episode occurs' false) and excluded middle on the existence of an occurring episode. The retorsion rests on the OPEN bridge STMT-COGITO-PERFORMED-DOUBT-IS-THOUGHT, so this route has the same open premises as COGITO-THOUGHT-OCCURS-FROM-PERFORMED-DOUBT; it uses the retorsion's negative form instead of the bridge directly.
